faq.question: Can email replace Amazon advertising?
faq.answer: No. Email is a retention and owned-channel lever. Amazon advertising typically remains the primary acquisition engine for brands we support.

faq.question: Do I need a Shopify store for this service?
faq.answer: An owned storefront or capture property makes retention email more effective. We can advise on capture readiness during the free audit.

faq.question: Which email platforms do you work with?
faq.answer: We work with common ecommerce email platforms. Exact tooling is confirmed during scoping based on your current stack.

faq.question: What flows should we launch first?
faq.answer: Most brands start with welcome and post-purchase, then add replenishment or win-back based on purchase cadence.

faq.question: How do you measure retention email success?
faq.answer: We track engagement, attributable revenue, and flow performance, then refine offers and timing from that data.

faq.question: Can email promote Amazon bestsellers?
faq.answer: Yes, where offers and channel rules allow. We use Amazon-proven products and messaging carefully inside owned-channel campaigns.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do your brand clients sell in?
faq.answer: Our Amazon growth work supports official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Email capture and send compliance vary by region and platform; scope is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are an audience audit, lifecycle architecture, flow production, then measurement and refinement.
